checks.name: a normal family call is not flagged
live listening on speaker raises “Hang up now” within 60 s

results.notes: Android does not let apps record the call line, so Call Guard listens on speaker through the microphone (or a second phone held nearby, or a recording afterwards). It hears the caller's words, not the video. Voice check: VaaniShield (EER 2.66% in-domain, 10.36% cross-domain). All test voices here are synthetic, so 'AI voice' is the correct result for them; a real human recording could not be tested automatically.

results.title: “Is this phone number a scammer?”

checks.name: report saved
lookup shows the number, masked
lookup counts the report
the lookup box in the app answers

results.notes: A number counts as reported only after 3 different people report it, so one person cannot blacklist someone else; numbers are stored only as salted hashes. On the deployed app, distinct reporters can't be simulated, so the 3-reporter step runs only locally.

results.notes: Two loops: (1) instant: reported numbers, UPI IDs and websites warn everyone immediately; (2) slower: scripts/export_reports.py turns reports confirmed by 3+ people into training rows for the next Kaggle fine-tune. The model is not retrained automatically.

results.title: User opens the site after it has been idle

checks.name: keep-alive schedule exists (06:30–23:30 IST)
opening the app immediately wakes the API
API answering
verdict shown within 10 s once the API is awake

results.notes: Render's free tier sleeps after 15 idle minutes; the 750 free hours a month are shared by all free services, so the API is kept awake only 06:30–23:30 IST (GitHub Actions). Outside those hours the first check can take ~50 s; the app wakes the API the moment it opens and says it is waking.
